inside.note: A craft: the game shows its death as a spark and hides it (godot/fx/fx_death.gd _wing_death); nothing breaks open. These few rooms are here because the build contract needs an inside (tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py); they cost few triangles.

changes: Length 1.6 (CLS_LEN Squadron; drawn 3.84 on the board), the same as the bomber, not the notes' 3.2 units
docs/playbooks/scale.md, Squadron rows, binding (it wins over the design notes): "same wing frame as a fighter, only its load differs"; the fighter reads apart by its slim outline, not its length
R1 is a low swept dorsal radiator on the stern block's forward slope, its peak below the stern roof, with no zigzag

Ryan (R302, issue 920): shrink the radiator tower into the concept's low back fin, no longer the tallest thing. The shoe extends forward from the original reactor socket so its panel sweeps back into the roofline; the reactor and all other parts are unchanged
The two drives are deep bells sunk in eight-sided armoured cowls in the stern face, smaller (0.077 across) and dim, not two big protruding drums with bright bells
the production notes: SF3's bells render oversized and brighter than banked coals, the sheet dims and shrinks them (R55); the owner's rule for craft: drives are nozzle clusters inside armoured blocks
The interceptor guns turn on a shallow traverse ring in an armoured well on the blade's back near the bow (the concept's dorsal bow recess), three barrels in one emitter cluster

data.js guns fires all round (arc T): the fit check sweeps the guns through every bearing, which a gun in the nose face cannot do; the notes let the sheet pick the dorsal recess or the nose face, and DeepSeek's traverse ring is in the callout (R241, ships.md rule 11)
The guns elevate to 45 degrees (the fit check's band 0 to 45)
interceptor guns engage craft above and below the wing; the fit check tests the same 0 to 45 degree band against the low radiator
An armoured sensor slit for the pilot in the stern block's sloping face
Ryan (R254): no canopy, an armoured slit at most; one unaugmented pilot, no AI (lore 2.5), so the pilot needs a view out
The concept's glowing flank slats are the drive room's heat louvres; its glyph decals and small panels are not modelled
every part has a job (R221); the decals are generator noise (production notes); fine greeble reads as a shrunken capital ship at this size (both design legs)
No hatches, lamps or attitude thrusters
below what the battle camera shows on a 3.84 unit craft (about 30 px long); the drives turn the craft; bold and simple (production notes)
A small inside: the gun feed, the pilot's cell, the reactor under the spire, the drive room; one seam (B-1)
the game shows a craft's death as a spark and hides it (fx_death.gd _wing_death), so nothing breaks open; the build contract needs an inside and a seam (tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py)
tbd: The frost-white oath stripe along the blade edge, the trim and the ember lines are paint: the Sunward stack (issue 756) applies later
How a sheet craft reaches the game: the game builds every craft in code today (godot/render/squadron_craft.gd), so no stage 7 export or install here

sheet.blend_where: rendered on Ryan's PC (Blender 4.5.14, Cycles CPU); `build.py voidsworn_SF3 <out> render` rebuilds it from this file
sheet.before_note: Issue 920 replaces only R1's tall radiator tower and its zigzag fins with a low swept radiator on the same mount.
sheet.during: The table above is every finding, in the order the check made them. Beyond the fit check, the sheet's own looks sent back: the first plating (small plates, many rivets) read as a shrunken capital ship, so the plates were made larger and the rivets smaller; the heat louvre's ember back plate stood in front of its slats on so small a louvre (the kit now keeps it behind them).

weapons.name: Interceptor guns
weapons.rules: data.js guns: 3 shots, 4 damage, range 1 (k sq), 82 aim, x2.2 against squadrons, x0.5 against capitals
weapons.lore: The wing's only weapon (lore 2.5: unaugmented crews, no AI: a pilot aims it). Battle look: guns (craft on a strafing run).
weapons.design: Three short barrels in one tight emitter cluster on a shallow traverse ring, sunk in an armoured well on the blade's back near the bow: a low faceted housing, a block mantlet, the three muzzles flared with dark bores. It turns (data.js arc T, the fit check sweeps it all round) and sits low, so nothing on the fighter reads as a turret on a jet.
